name: ViDoRe
description: ViDoRe (Visual Document Retrieval Benchmark) is the original page-level visual document retrieval benchmark introduced alongside the ColPali model. Given a natural-language query, systems must retrieve the correct document page from a corpus of page images without relying on extracted text — evaluating the ability to reason over layout, tables, figures, fonts, and infographics as visual signals.
reputation: High-impact benchmark introduced with ColPali (ICLR 2025); quickly became the standard for visual document retrieval. Top models exceeded 90% nDCG@5, indicating saturation by 2025.
notes: 10 sub-benchmarks spanning diverse document types: arxivqa, docvqa, infovqa, tabfquad, tatdqa, shiftproject, and four syntheticDocQA domains (AI, energy, government, healthcare). Queries mostly synthetic or repurposed from QA datasets. English and French. Succeeded by ViDoRe v2 and v3 due to benchmark saturation.
